errors.text_span: в сферата на храните и напитките
errors.evidence: The description adds the phrase 'in the sphere of food and drinks', which is not present in the figure's title or labels. This information seems to be taken from the paper's title provided in the context, but it is not part of the visual information in the chart itself.
The description states the value is 77.61%, which is incorrect. The actual values on the chart are 87.61% and 12.39%.

errors.text_span: Секторът "Рекламни слогани без реторични фигури" е зает с 77,61%, представен от светлосиньо.
errors.evidence: This sentence incorrectly assigns attributes to the category 'Advertising slogans without rhetorical figures'. According to the figure, this category corresponds to the red slice and has a value of 12.39%, not the blue slice with a misreported value of 77.61%.

errors.text_span: Секторът "Рекламни слогани с реторични фигури" е зает с 12,39%, представен от червено.
errors.evidence: This sentence incorrectly assigns attributes to the category 'Advertising slogans with rhetorical figures'. According to the figure, this category corresponds to the blue slice and has a value of 87.61%, not the red slice with a value of 12.39%.
The phrase 'Не сектор е визуално подчертан' is grammatically incorrect in Bulgarian. A correct phrasing would be 'Нито един сектор не е визуално подчертан' (No sector is visually emphasized).
